verdict.rationale: The README documents a short install path: two `/plugin` commands, plus fallbacks of pasting a single SKILL.md into a chat or copying folders into `.claude/skills/`. That suggests a fast setup, but there is no explicit quickstart guide, no timing claim, and no step to confirm the installed skill works. The docs probe also returned a 404. missing for 10: a documented end-to-end quickstart with a first-run verification step, evidence that setup takes under five minutes, independent or hands-on corroboration of the install flow.

support.subject: As a developer, a quickstart takes me from nothing to a working installed skill in under five minutes

citations.quote: Paste any single `SKILL.md` at the top of a chat and it runs as a mode.
copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`.
